captioner.prompt_template:
You see a product image from an online store. The product title is: "{title}".
Describe ONLY visual information that is NOT already stated in the title.
Do not repeat or transcribe any words printed on the product, box, or cover.
Answer in at most 40 words as "key: value" pairs, choosing only relevant keys from:
color, material, shape/form factor, included items, art style, characters or scene shown, mood/theme, target audience cues, condition.
If the image clearly shows a different kind of product than the title, answer exactly: MISMATCH.
captioner.mismatch_policy: Preserve the row and raw MISMATCH output; mark caption_status=mismatch and use unavailable in all caption-dependent arms.
captioner.revision_resolution: Resolve once from Hugging Face model_info; store the immutable model and processor revisions in every run identity.

paraphraser.selection_note: Approved after real 300-item title-only probe: 1/300 clear unsupported additions (0.33%), versus approximately 54/300 (18%) for Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. Remaining fidelity concerns and the non-Apache license must be disclosed. See ISSUES.md #16.

runtime.scope: LLM2Rec training runtime only; do not load Qwen3-VL here.

caption_runtime.torch: Use the Kaggle image's preinstalled build; do not upgrade.
caption_runtime.scope: Qwen3-VL caption generation only; isolated from training.

budget.scope: full corpus generation, tiny end-to-end validation, and full training matrix
budget.stop_rule: Do not start a new job if projected cumulative GPU-hours would exceed 30; stop scheduling before the cap and preserve completed artifacts.

resolved_revisions_note: Qwen3-VL model and processor revisions are resolved from Hugging Face model_info in the pre-run smoke and recorded by immutable SHA; full corpus generation remains blocked until all 100 structured pilot labels pass the gate above.
